column1: # JLPT N5–N1 vocabulary: Jonathan Waller's lists (tanos.co.uk, CC BY), with JMdict ids and spelling
# fixes by stephenmk/yomitan-jlpt-vocab (CC BY-SA 4.0) at commit b062d4e38c4bdd0950ae1d4ec55f04b176182e03.
# The JLPT publishes no official word list; these are the lists jisho.org uses.
# level<TAB>key<TAB>headword. The key is SudachiDict core 20261015's normalized form (mode C) of the
# headword (and of the kana for words usually written in kana), as hanstat keys a book's words.
# An entry Sudachi splits into an affix and one word (お菓子, 五つ) is keyed by that word.
# Each key once, at its easiest level (5 = N5). 133 set phrases that are not one word are left out.
